mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(dic.area,0) AS area,SUM(rt.bps) AS bps ,#{push} AS time FROM (SELECT t.node_ip AS ip,SUM(t.speed) AS bps FROM ( SELECT RECV_TIME,NODE_IP,INOCTETS_SPEED+OUTOCTETS_SPEED AS speed FROM traffic_netflow_port_info WHERE RECV_TIME >= #{start} AND RECV_TIME < #{end} ) t GROUP BY ip ) rt LEFT JOIN (SELECT entrance_id AS area,manager_ip AS ip FROM ntc_device_info GROUP BY area,ip ) dic ON dic.ip = rt.ip GROUP BY area
SELECT b.type,concat(#{ip},#{serverPort},b.url) AS url ,b.datetime AS time FROM( SELECT type ,max(id) id FROM image_url WHERE module = #{type} GROUP BY type) a LEFT JOIN image_url b ON a.id=b.id;
